dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Lyney's magic shows are amazing! Paimon never would've guessed how he did it before he revealed his secret.

dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: Hold on... I just thought of a magic trick!

dialogues.speaker: Paimon
dialogues.text: Huh? You know how to do magic too?

choices.text: Yep. I can make a big magician's hat float in the air...

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Whoa! Really? How do you do that?

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Hehe, simple! I put Paimon inside the hat.

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: What? Why would Paimon be... Ohhh, so Paimon's the one making it float!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Hehe, in that case, Paimon has an idea for an even better magic trick!

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Behold, the bottomless hat! No matter how many plates of delicious food you throw into it, it'll never get full!

response.speaker: Player
response.text: Uh... Wait, so where would the plates go?

response.speaker: Paimon
response.text: Oh, good point! Umm... Oh, the hat spits the empty plates back out! Tada! Whaddya think?

choices.text: And even make it move at my command.
